verdict.rationale: No evidence item says whether GlitchTip uses customer data to train AI models, and none documents an opt-out or a no-training policy. The nearby evidence is adjacent rather than about this story: the MCP server pulls your own data into AI tools "with no data sharing required," the product can be self-hosted as open source, and hosted users can delete their data. None of these is a documented guarantee or control against AI training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
